Summit Application
Candidate Showcase · Lead Developer / Co-Creator

Digitizing blood donation in Niger to save lives in under 30 minutes.

Sang Solidaire (sang-solidaire.app) is a digital emergency medical coordination platform designed to instantly connect Niamey hospitals and the National Blood Transfusion Center (CNTS) with nearby compatible volunteer donors when blood is urgently needed.

Niamey, Niger SDG 3 — Good Health & Well-being SDG 9 — Innovation & Infrastructure SMS Alerts & PostGIS Geolocation MVP Prototype in Active Finalization
Explore Proof of Work My Role & Contribution
The Initiative & Goal

Solving a local health crisis through software engineering.

In Niamey hospitals, blood shortages during accidents, childbirth, or emergency surgeries cause preventable loss of life. Sang Solidaire transforms this critical emergency into a seamless digital coordination workflow.

The Challenge / Problem

Finding blood donors traditionally relies on informal family calls or social media requests. This manual process takes hours, when a patient's survival is decided within the first few minutes.

The Solution (sang-solidaire.app)

A web and mobile platform pairing the required blood type with the PostGIS geographic location of registered donors. When a doctor creates a request, the system automatically alerts eligible nearby donors via SMS.

International Summit Application · Evidence of Leadership & Engineering Skills

My Technical Involvement & Role in Sang Solidaire

As a software engineer and lead developer, I actively contribute to the overall architecture and technical development of sang-solidaire.app. This project embodies my core commitment: leveraging software engineering to solve critical social challenges in Africa.

Backend Architecture & Spatial DB

Designed the Node.js (Express / TypeScript) REST API and modeled the PostgreSQL database enriched with PostGIS for real-time geographic proximity calculations.

Advanced Matching Algorithm

Engineered the blood compatibility algorithm (ABO & Rh factor system) combined with kilometer radius filtering and donor eligibility window management.

Responsive React Frontends

Developed frontend web applications using React 18 / Vite / Tailwind CSS for 3 user profiles (Donors, Hospital Medical Staff, CNTS Administrators).

Network Resilience & SMS Gateways

Integrated SMS dispatch gateways (Africa's Talking & Twilio) and established offline queues to handle intermittent network connectivity in Niger.

Product Architecture

The 3 Platform Workspaces

Each module is tailored to the specific operational needs and connectivity levels of its users.

1. Donor Space

Ultra-fast phone onboarding with SMS OTP verification. Donors enter their blood type, neighborhood, and receive targeted emergency alerts.

2. Medical Staff Space

Dedicated interface for healthcare professionals in Niamey hospitals to issue urgent blood requests, trigger automated matching, and track donor arrivals.

3. CNTS Admin Dashboard

Analytical supervision tool for the National Blood Transfusion Center: inventory mapping, donor density per zone, and hospital account management.
